title: Static Belly-Resting Four-Flipper Seal
description: One newly authored stylised resting seal exterior. A continuous blunt raised head and short neck flow into a thick broad belly and tapering rear torso; four distinct thick flattened flippers comprise two swept lateral foreflippers and a paired splayed rear set. The torso has a real finite low belly patch. Two small side eyes, two blunt muzzle lobes and a small dark nose complete the face. All body station proportions and flipper outlines are newly authored, not a fish given legs, recoloured ray, cropped rabbit or a modified old animal. Ten closed editable meshes, three opaque matte PBR materials, no texture, fur simulation, gill slit, dorsal fin, tail fluke, teeth or scene. Metres, native Z up, head -Y and actual horizontal bounds-centred ground datum. One complete static prop and zero scenes. Illustrative seal-like shape only, not exact species identification, anatomical specimen, rig, breathing, locomotion, swimming, buoyancy, biological fidelity, handling or animal safety guidance.
